asset.subject: Indonesia: MSCI consults on reclassification
asset.body: MSCI is consulting on moving Indonesia from Emerging Market to Standalone, with a decision targeted by end-June 2027. OJK plans disclosure and free-float reforms. Reuters reported an 11.6% index fall and cited bank estimates of US$3–6bn in potential passive outflows. No reclassification decision has been made.

evidence.fact: MSCI launched a consultation to reclassify Indonesia from Emerging Market to Standalone, retaining restrictions and targeting a final decision by the end of June 2027.
OJK responded with planned disclosures above 1%, investor classification, holding-company reporting and a higher free-float roadmap.
Reuters reported an 11.6% index fall, roughly US$65 billion of value erased and bank estimates of US$3-6 billion in passive outflows.
